lead.claim: Prehabilitation exercise may improve ankle surgery outcomes and speed return to sport.
lead.context: *Why this matters*: A 4-week exercise program before arthroscopic Broström procedure for chronic ankle instability showed better functional recovery and faster return to sports at 2 years.

supporting.claim: Therapists' confidence and resources impact stroke walking program delivery.
supporting.context: *Why this matters*: Therapists believe high-dose walking training is important but need confidence and resources to ensure patients complete it.

supporting.claim: Early exercise adherence after hip fracture surgery links to better function.
supporting.context: *Why this matters*: Moderate early functional exercise adherence in older adults after hip fracture surgery was associated with better 3-month hip functional recovery.

supporting.claim: Robot-assisted walking in schools may increase participation for children with physical disabilities.
supporting.context: This pilot randomized crossover trial found that robot-assisted walking in schools was feasible and showed potential for improving participation for children with physical disabilities.
